item.title: Muse Code 1.4.24
item.description: exec --list-models lists available models: If you run exec in the terminal and mistype the --model name, you can fix it without leaving the screen.

item.title: Muse Code 1.4.23

item.title: Muse Code 1.4.22
item.description: Auto-review no longer saves a separate conversation log: Sessions now take up less disk space. Auto-review no longer saves the reviewer's own conversation as a separate log file.

item.title: Muse Code 1.4.21
item.description: /resume Marks Chats Waiting for Input Live: When picking up where you left off, you used to have to open each session one by one to see which one had paused for your reply.

item.title: Muse Code 1.4.19
item.description: Claude models can now read images directly: Pasting a screenshot of a report to ask Claude to check the numbers used to fail the entire turn as soon as you sent it.

item.title: Muse Code 1.4.17
item.description: Improved Agent Blocker Reporting and Build Debugging: When development tasks run into a blocked network, a behind branch, or a form, Muse now responds in a different order.

item.title: Muse Code 1.4.16
item.description: Editors can invoke Muse directly through default-on muse acp: When you want an agent's help directly inside your editor, having to open an interface by hand first often adds an extra step.
